budget.billing_caveat: Runtime-reported completed-step cost multiplied by 100; not provider-billing reconciliation.

decision_basis: Neither challenger reached the frozen 5/5 plus clean-zero threshold. Both reproduced the historical 3 detected, 1 missed, 1 ambiguous attribution. Astra preserved clean-zero; GPT-6.1 Sol reported one material finding on the clean control. Efficiency cannot override the quality block.

preregistered_outcomes.NO_CHALLENGER_PASSES_THRESHOLD: Observed. No quality-profile Reviewer decision is unlocked.
preregistered_outcomes.CREDIBLE_CANDIDATE_BELOW_THRESHOLD: Not observed: neither challenger improved beyond the historical three detections.

limitations: One dispatch per model per case does not establish reliability.
The Opus 5.5 reference ran on OpenCode 1.18.31 with different runner, plugin and instruction context; comparison is historical rather than contemporaneous.
R-CONCURRENCY remains fail-closed ambiguous because multiple material findings target the same override and the case has no witness.
R-BOUNDARY was missed by both challengers, as it was by the historical reference.

GPT-6.1 Sol's clean-control finding identifies a real error-handling defect in clean/counter.sh: an unreadable but writable counter can be overwritten with 1 while the function reports success. The frozen clean-zero contract penalizes that correct finding. Rescoring is forbidden, and Sol already blocks at three of five seeded detections.

Reviewer workload ledger rows use agent dispatch and therefore leave provider empty and variant resolved; the retained resolved-config snapshots establish the concrete Copilot model and variant identities.
The freeze was manifest-bound but deliberately uncommitted under the task constraint; Git HEAD does not contain the protocol files.
